messages:
maya.ramirez: Heads-up — launching the ephemeral docs sandbox on prod in ~5m. This enables runnable examples with short-lived tokens and an opt-in embed consent flow. :rocket:

docs-bot: deploy: docs-site v3.4.0 -> prod (feature: ephemeral-sandbox enabled)

pranav.singh: Nice. What's the default expiry for those sandbox tokens?

maya.ramirez: Default TTL is 15m. Org admins can configure max TTL via Console > Devtools > Sandbox. For Dedicated/Private we'll add an enterprise config.

lina: Do we need to change the snippets in the examples repo? We have a bunch of demos that assume long-lived demo tokens.

maya.ramirez: Short answer: yes, a small subset. We added a runner shim for local dev that can refresh tokens automatically (`rw-docs auth refresh`) but CI and external embeds will need a migration: either use service tokens (recommended) or call the ephemeral token endpoint before each run.

maya.ramirez: Quick curl example for calling the sandbox endpoint:
```
# curl example (ephemeral token)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL_TOKEN>" \
  -X POST https://docs.redwood.ai/sandbox/v1/run \
  -d '{"snippet":"print(\"hello from sandbox\")"}'
```

maya.ramirez: And using the docs CLI: 
```
# run a snippet in the ephemeral sandbox for 15 minutes
rw-docs run --ephemeral --ttl 15m examples/quickstart.py
```

pranav.singh: Will this impact embedded Playgrounds that partners host on their sites?

maya.ramirez: We changed the embed flow: hosts must pass `embed_session=true` when requesting a token. The first time a browser hits an embed it will show a short consent modal (we log consent). No JS API changes beyond the new query param.

ethan: Docs team — can we get a short banner in Quickstart and a migration script that replaces old demo tokens with a call to the ephemeral-token endpoint?

maya.ramirez: Yes. PR is open: docs#8109 (contains banner copy, migration bash script, and updated CI example). Please review.

pranav.singh: I'll add support in the Python and JS SDKs to make obtaining ephemeral tokens easier (helper: `client.get_ephemeral_token(ttl="15m")`). Targeting a patch release next Wednesday. Will gate with env var `RW_EPHEMERAL_SANDBOX` until everything's signed off.

lina: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 10-min demo tomorrow at 9:30am PT to walk through the new flow and the PR.

docs-bot: Note: docs#8109 deployed to staging. If you see any snippet breakage, please comment on the PR.

maya.ramirez: Action items: 1) Reviews for docs#8109 (lina, ethan) 2) SDK patch PRs (pranav) 3) Quickstart banner + migration note (docs team) — target rollout Friday EOD.

pranav.singh: Ack. I'll post follow-up in #eng when SDK PRs are ready.

maya.ramirez: Thanks all — will post a short changelog blurb and a newsletter note for partners.

docs-bot: Thread archived by docs-bot after 24h inactivity.
